svg.title: Tire (tp::tire): traction, side grip and motion resistance on soil (Brixius)

g.text: Tire (tp::tire): traction, side grip and motion resistance on soil (Brixius)
δ = δ_ref p_ref / p; limit loses
on a Footing: the same results, worked out once per step
+traction(const Params&, wheel_m_s, ground_m_s, load_n, const Surface&) : Traction
+driven_rolling_resistance(const Size&, load_n, slip_ratio, const Surface&) : double
+towed_rolling_resistance(const Size&, load_n, const Surface&, own_losses) : double
+thrown_soil_m3_s(const Size&, load_n, slip_ratio, wheel_m_s, const Surface&) : double
+dig_depth_m(const Params&, depth_m, slip_m_s, ground_m_s, dt_s) : double
+side_grip(const Size&, const Cornering&, load_n, const Surface&) : SideGrip
+with_traction(SideGrip, const Traction&, load_n) : SideGrip (side grip × k(v))
Bn = CI b d / W · (1 + 5 δ/h) / (1 + 3 b/d)
μ(s) = g · limit h(CI) (1 - e^(-mobility_rate Bn)) (1 - e^(-slip_rate |s|)) (1 - f s²) k(v)
h(CI) = unsunk + (1 - unsunk) min(1, lug_bearing / CI): lugs ride on ground too hard for them
k(v) = slow + (fast - slow) (1 - e^(-|v| / spin_speed)), v the slip speed:
a puller tire bites harder spinning fast (slow < 1), a farm tire smears (fast < 1);
with fall_speed: k = (1 - (1 - slow) e^(-v/spin)) (fast + (1 - fast) e^(-v/fall)), rising then easing
thrown soil: width · diameter · driven resistance · |wheel surface speed|;
the soil's reaction on the tread, as traction: kThrownShare (0.1) · ρ_loose · V' · v_slip
digging: depth' = rate |v_slip| e^(-|v| / escape) - depth |v| / r (implicit, ≤ h);
the hole holds the body back with W · min(depth / √(2 r δ), √(2 depth / r), 1)
side grip: C = stiffness · g m W, F_max = limit · g m W, m = 1 - e^(-rate Bn);
patch deflection d: F = -(C/σ) d, d' = v_lat - |v_roll| d / σ (implicit), slides at F_max;
traction uses it up: F_max · √(1 - (F_x / full bite)²) · (1 - |s|)
force over a step = force_n + force_per_slip_speed * change in slip speed
(linearly implicit; slope >= 0, so explicit beyond the peak)
